response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior full-stack engineer with nearly two decades of hands-on development across many stacks, but the profile does not match the core of this Principal IC6 role. There is no evidence of building experimentation platforms, feature-flagging systems, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth measurement systems, nor of leading multi-workstream initiatives at enterprise scale. Most experience is product feature development at small-to-mid-sized companies rather than platform architecture enabling multiple teams, and statistical/experimental analysis depth is absent.
strengths: 18+ years of broad, hands-on engineering experience across web, backend, mobile, and embedded systems
High-scale distributed systems exposure (low-latency microservices handling millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Strong craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, teaching, and mentoring via workshops
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature flighting, or growth measurement systems
Career trajectory is senior/staff IC at small companies; no evidence of principal-level, cross-team platform ownership at enterprise scale
No visible depth in statistical methods, metrics design, telemetry infrastructure, or data-driven decision systems

key_factors.factor: Scope gap vs. Principal IC6 cross-team leadership expectations
Strong general engineering fundamentals and scale exposure
